what: Four horizontal bars (30px high each) are stacked between a light section and a dark section. From when the band head passes 75% of the screen until the band bottom edge reaches 75%, the bars grow from 0 to 1 with the top as the axis — the lower bars start first (the i-th from the top is delayed by (n−1−i)/n × .5 of progress) so they all finish together at the end, making the dark section below look like it spreads upward in steps. Tied directly to scroll (scrub true), no curve

options.spread: Share by which the first bar starts late (progress ratio), default .5
options.origin: Axis the bars grow along, default top (grows downward)

note: Bar color is --fx-bar (default --kf-contrast-bg) — keep it the same as the background of the section right below. Band height is --fx-height

from.where: index.js · index.html .sr-stair (original .layerAnime .layerAnime_shift_layer — between the WORKS section and the dark PROJECT STORY section)
